title: A test that failed in make check-quick was not flaky: the gate let the owner's OpenAI key serve the intern in a test
request: test_agents_traces.py's API intern test failed once in make check-quick under heavy load: it expected the standard plan's trace ['list_samples'] and got 24 tool calls. Find the shared state that leaks a model between tests, make the test independent of it, and prove the fix with a reproduction that fails before.
spec: CLAUDE.md: tests never reach a live model (DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1, scripted transports); .github/workflows/ci.yml runs tests with DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1 and an empty OPENAI_API_KEY.
plan: Read the failing run's kept output (training_records/test_runs/2026-10-21/) before guessing at test order.
Follow how the API's intern gets its model: Services -> gateway.client('intern') -> the tier's key and DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS.
Reproduce without spending: a fake OpenAI-compatible server on localhost and a fake key, in check-quick's environment.
Fix where the environment is made (the runner and the Makefile), and make the test hold whatever the environment.

decisions.decision: Fix the test runner's environment, not only the one test.
decisions.why: The fake model also received 10 stage-explanation requests from other tests in the same file that still passed: every test that reaches a model path spent the owner's money silently under check-quick.

decisions.decision: The runner forces DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1 (not setdefault) and blanks OPENAI_API_KEY in every test process.
decisions.why: This is CI's environment; rd-check already ran the whole suite with the switch on, and every test that needs a key or the switch off patches it itself.

create_app installs its gateway for the process and never uninstalls it, but the reproduction showed later tests reach the model through a fresh Gateway() just the same: it is not the cause, and changing server shutdown is outside this fix.

decisions.decision: Never reproduce with the real key.
decisions.why: The failing path spends money on a live model; the fake server shows the same behaviour and counts the requests.

change: tests/run_parallel.py (child_env: DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1, OPENAI_API_KEY blanked), Makefile (check-quick, check-quick-tests, agent-test export DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1), tests/test_agents_traces.py (the API test sets the switch itself), tests/test_run_capture.py (NoLiveModelTest)

findings.defect: make check-quick ran tests with a live model: the API test's intern was planned by the owner's OpenAI model (24 tool calls, 224 s for the file) instead of the standard plan.
findings.scenario: make check-quick with test_agents_traces.py among the affected files, the owner's .env holding OPENAI_API_KEY.
findings.cause: dclab_rnd/agentic/server.py loads .env on import (without override); tests/run_parallel.py blanked only the Anthropic settings; the Makefile exported DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1 for rd-check and check-all but not check-quick, so the gateway's switch was off and the standard tier had a key.
findings.fix: run_parallel.child_env forces DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1 and blanks OPENAI_API_KEY for every test process; check-quick, check-quick-tests and agent-test export the switch.
findings.test: tests/test_run_capture.py NoLiveModelTest (fails on main: no child_env, check-quick missing from the export line)

findings.defect: The failure was read as flakiness under load; it was deterministic in one gate and absent in the other.
findings.scenario: Passed alone and in make rd-check (which exports the switch), failed in make check-quick (which did not). The run record's env field was {} for the failing run.
findings.cause: The run record keeps DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS when set; its absence was the clue, not the load.
findings.fix: None needed in the record; the lesson is to read the environment of a gate-only failure first.
findings.test: the reproduction script (fake model): fails on main every time, no load needed

findings.defect: The API test depended on the gate for its own premise (no model serves the intern).
findings.scenario: python -m unittest test_agents_traces with OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment.
findings.cause: Nothing in the test switched live models off.
findings.fix: The test patches DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1 around create_app.
findings.test: the test run directly with a fake key and a fake model: passes, 0 requests

findings.defect: Two comments named too little: the gateway's docstring listed only rd-check, test-pg and product-e2e as switching live models off, and the runner's comment named one module as the one that loads .env.
findings.scenario: A reader trusting the docstring would think make check-quick and the runner leave the switch to the caller.
findings.cause: The comments were written when only those places set it.
findings.fix: The docstring names the runner and every gate that runs tests; the runner's comment says server.py is one loader among others.
findings.test: none (comments); the reviewer found no correctness issue: no target needs a live model through the runner, the no-fork path gets the same environment, agent-test is only helped

findings.defect: make agent-test does not go through the runner, so before this fix the owner's OpenAI key from .env reached its pytest run with the switch off.
findings.scenario: make agent-test on the owner's machine.
findings.cause: agent-test exported the Anthropic blanks but not DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS.
findings.fix: agent-test is on the Makefile's export line; the gateway refuses the real transport with the switch on.

measurements.name: reproduction: test_agents_traces.py through tests/run_parallel.py in check-quick's environment, fake key, fake model on localhost
measurements.gate: fails before the fix, passes after it, the fake model receives no request after it
measurements.result: main: FAIL (trace ['write_plan', 'finish']), 12 requests (2 intern, 10 stage explanations); fix: OK, 0 requests
limits: a fake model stands in for the live one; the failing live run is known only from its kept output

measurements.name: the named test files and the runner's and gateway's tests
measurements.gate: test_agents_traces, test_intern, test_agent_harness, test_run_capture, test_models_gateway pass

measurements.name: 13 files that set or blank OPENAI_API_KEY themselves
measurements.gate: pass with the key blanked by the runner
limits: not the whole suite; rd-check already runs it with the switch on, and CI with the key empty

outcome: Every test process the runner starts is as CI's: no live model, no OpenAI key, whichever gate started it. The test that failed is deterministic and holds on its own. Past check-quick runs may have spent on the owner's OpenAI key.
lessons: A failure that appears in one gate and not another is about the gate's environment before it is about load or order.
A switch exported per make target is easy to miss on a new target; put it where the processes are made (the runner) as well.
Reproduce a spending path with a fake endpoint that counts requests: it shows every caller, not only the failing one.
risks: Make targets that run tests without tests/run_parallel.py (pytest under .venv-agent, scripts) rely on the Makefile's export line only.
Other keys in .env (TABPFN_TOKEN, connector tokens) are not blanked; DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS covers the model gateway only.
models.install keeps a closed app's gateway as the process's fallback; harmless here, but a later test reads a deleted workspace's routing and usage log.
